title: Refactor xtask into modules

in: Split xtask implementation into modules (cli.rs for clap types; cbd/* handlers; util/* helpers) while keeping main.rs minimal.
Preserve cbd CLI surface (subcommands, flags/args, requiredness, defaults) and help output exit code behavior (help exits 0).
Preserve validate-ready/verify exit codes and output text as specified by this contract.
Preserve new-task/new-epic/new-review scaffolding outputs as template-derived files with placeholder/section replacement rules specified in this contract.
Keep template files and generated outputs unchanged.
out: Add new CLI flags or subcommands.
Change exit codes, error handling semantics, or verification logic.
Change template contents, JSON schemas, or generated output formats/paths.
Change interactive prompt wording or add new prompts (not specified by this contract).

postconditions.statement: If the contract file exists, parses as JSON, has status "ready", and open_questions is missing, null, or an empty array, the command exits with code 0 and prints "Contract <id> is ready.".

errors.when: The contract file .cbd/contracts/<id>.contract.json does not exist.
The contract file exists but is invalid JSON.
errors.response: Exit code 3 and prints a line starting with "Invalid JSON in <path>:" (including the parse error).

errors.when: The contract status is not "ready" (including missing or non-string) or open_questions is a non-empty array or present but not an array/null.
errors.response:
Exit code 4 and prints:
Contract <id> not ready:
  status="<status>"
  open_questions=<json>

postconditions.statement: If all gates pass (contract status is "ready" or "implemented" with open_questions missing/null/empty array, bundle coverage, evidence coverage, and checks), the command exits with code 0 and prints "cbd verify <id>: OK".

errors.when: The contract, bundle, or evidence file is missing.

Contract/bundle/evidence JSON is invalid or structural validation fails (invalid clause ids, invalid acceptance_tests.proves, invalid bundle structure, unknown clause ids in phases.build[].proves, evidence contract_id mismatch, or invalid evidence proofs).
errors.response:
Exit code 3 and prints one of:
- "Invalid JSON in <path>: ..."
- "Contract <id> is ready, but clauses are invalid: ..."
- "Contract <id> acceptance_tests[].proves is invalid: ..."
- "Invalid bundle.json in <path>: ..."
- "Bundle references unknown clause ids in phases.build[].proves:" followed by "  - <id>" lines
- "Invalid evidence.json in <path>: ..."
- "Evidence contract_id mismatch in <path>: expected \"<id>\", got <value>"

errors.when: Contract status is not "ready" or "implemented" (including missing or non-string), or open_questions is a non-empty array or present but not an array/null.
errors.response:
Exit code 4 and prints:
Contract <id> not ready/implemented:
  status="<status>"
  open_questions=<json>

errors.when: Bundle planning coverage is missing or evidence lacks required clause proofs.
errors.response:
Exit code 4 and prints either:
- "Bundle planning coverage missing for contract <id>: <n>/<n> clauses not assigned" followed by "  - <id>" lines
- "Missing clause proofs for contract <id>: <n>/<n>" followed by "  - <id>" lines

errors.when: Cargo or TypeScript checks invoked by verify fail.
errors.response: Exit code 1; stderr includes "<tool> exited with code <n>" (after a "==> (cd ...) <tool> ..." line on stdout).

system_invariants.statement: Clap CLI surface includes exactly these cbd subcommands and flags/args with requiredness/defaults: new-task (--id required, --slug required, --force default false, --interactive default false), new-epic (--id required, --slug required, --force default false, --interactive default false), new-review (--id required, --slug required, --title optional, --force default false, --interactive default false), validate-ready (--id required), verify (--id required). Default clap flags (e.g., --help, --version) are permitted.
Help output renders successfully (exit code 0) for `xtask --help`, `xtask cbd --help`, and each cbd subcommand `--help`.
xtask/src/main.rs defines only `fn main` and `fn run` and does not define `cbd_*` handler functions; cbd command logic is delegated to the cbd module.
Clap derive types (Cli, CbdCommand, NewTaskArgs, NewEpicArgs, NewReviewArgs, ValidateReadyArgs, VerifyArgs) are defined in xtask/src/cli.rs.
cbd dispatch lives in xtask/src/cbd/mod.rs and each cbd subcommand handler is implemented in its own module file: new_task.rs, new_epic.rs, new_review.rs, validate_ready.rs, verify.rs.
Shared helper modules are defined under xtask/src/util/{paths,fs,json,template,prompt,process}.rs; main.rs contains no helper utilities beyond main/run.
xtask/Cargo.toml dependencies remain exactly: anyhow, clap (derive), serde_json.

Interactive scaffolding uses template files as the base and applies only placeholder + section replacements (no other edits):
- new-task: .cbd/tasks/TEMPLATE.md with <ID> and <short title> replacements; replace sections Goal, User story, In scope, Out of scope, Acceptance scenarios (examples-first), Context, Constraints, Dependencies, Unknowns when non-empty inputs are provided.
- new-epic: .cbd/requirements/TEMPLATE.epic.md with <EPIC_ID>, <TITLE>, <slug>, <epic_id> replacements; replace sections Problem, Target users / stakeholders, Goals (outcomes), Success metrics, In scope, Out of scope / Non-goals, Constraints, Integrations / dependencies, User stories, Acceptance scenarios (examples-first), Open questions when non-empty inputs are provided.
- new-review: copy .cbd/reviews/TEMPLATE/** with <REVIEW_ID>, <slug>, <TITLE> replacements; rewrite review.seed.md from template with replacements and replace Kind:, Date:, and sections What is being reviewed?, In scope, Out of scope, Assumptions, Primary assets (initial), External systems / integrations, Security / privacy constraints (explicit), Known risks / incidents / history (if any) when non-empty inputs are provided.

Non-interactive scaffolding writes outputs derived from templates with placeholder replacement only plus fixed JSON field updates:
- new-task: write .cbd/tasks/<id>-<slug>.md from .cbd/tasks/TEMPLATE.md with <ID>/<SLUG> replacements; write .cbd/contracts/<id>.contract.json and .cbd/bundles/<id>.bundle.json from templates with id/title/slug fields set; write .cbd/reports/<id>.evidence.md from template with <ID> replacement and .cbd/reports/<id>.evidence.json with contract_id set.
- new-epic: write .cbd/requirements/<id>-<slug>.md from TEMPLATE.epic.md with <EPIC_ID>/<TITLE>/<slug>/<epic_id> replacements; write .cbd/requirements/<id>-<slug>.tasklist.json from TEMPLATE.tasklist.json with epic_id/slug/title/status set and tasks = [].
- new-review: copy .cbd/reviews/TEMPLATE/** to .cbd/reviews/<id>-<slug>/ with <REVIEW_ID>/<slug>/<TITLE> replacements only.

acceptance_tests.description: Help output exits 0 for: `cargo run --manifest-path xtask/Cargo.toml -- --help`, `cargo run --manifest-path xtask/Cargo.toml -- cbd --help`, and each cbd subcommand help (`new-task`, `new-epic`, `new-review`, `validate-ready`, `verify`).

Validate the cbd subcommand surface via Clap metadata: subcommands and flags match the contract list, --id/--slug required where specified, --force/--interactive defaulting false, and new-review --title optional.

Verify module layout: main.rs defines only main/run and contains no cbd_* handlers; cli.rs defines the clap types; cbd/mod.rs dispatches to cbd/* handler files; util modules exist under xtask/src/util/{paths,fs,json,template,prompt,process}.rs.
Parse xtask/Cargo.toml and assert dependencies are exactly: anyhow, clap (derive), serde_json.
Run interactive scaffolding tests to confirm outputs match templates with only the placeholder + section replacements described in XT-INV-008 for new-task/new-epic/new-review.

Run non-interactive scaffolding tests that execute `cbd new-task`, `cbd new-epic`, and `cbd new-review` and compare outputs against the template-driven replacements and JSON field updates described in XT-INV-009.

Exercise `cbd validate-ready` with: missing contract (exit 2, "Missing contract: <path>"), invalid JSON (exit 3, line starts with "Invalid JSON in <path>:"), not ready/open_questions (exit 4, prints "Contract <id> not ready:" + status/open_questions lines; include open_questions non-array case), ready (exit 0, "Contract <id> is ready."; include open_questions missing and null cases).

Exercise `cbd verify` with: missing artifacts (exit 2, "Missing contract|bundle|evidence: <path>"), invalid JSON/schema cases (exit 3 with the VFY-ERR-002 message prefixes), not ready/open_questions (exit 4, "Contract <id> not ready/implemented:" + status/open_questions lines; include open_questions non-array case), missing planning coverage vs missing proofs (exit 4 with the VFY-ERR-004 prefixes and id lists), checks failing (exit 1, stderr includes "<tool> exited with code <n>" after a "==> (cd ...) <tool> ..." line), and a successful run (exit 0, "cbd verify <id>: OK"; include open_questions missing/null cases).

assumptions: Template files under .cbd/**/TEMPLATE* and .cbd/reviews/TEMPLATE/** are unchanged by this refactor; template changes are handled by a separate contract.
definition_of_done: each clause id in pre/post/invariants/errors has a proof entry in evidence.json
Rust enforcement is authoritative; TypeScript enforcement is UX-only
